name: Nulevoj kilometr
source:
After disturbing the silence of a Karelian forest, a young woman finds herself trapped, where the only way to survive is through honest conversations with people just as lost as she is. Through urban legends and shared stories, they must remember what brought them there and choose between redemption and eternal oblivion.
But the forest hears everything, and some paths offer no way back.
